relationships.subject: anti-VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) medications are specific inhibitors of the primary mediators of neovascularization.

relationships.subject: anti-VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Anti-VEGFs as an adjunct to conventional treatment could help reduce IOP in NVG in the short term (four to six weeks), but there is no evidence that this is likely in the longer term.

key_findings: Five RCTs: anti-VEGF adjunct reduced IOP in neovascular glaucoma in the short term (4-6 weeks); long-term evidence insufficient.
